notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Third Path Iconoclast
description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Third Path Iconoclast triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.

uses.name: Venture Forth
uses.cardState: with three or fewer time counters on it
